title: Multi--black holes in Bertotti--Robinson spacetime
summary: We construct a new class of exact solutions describing multi-black holes in the Bertotti--Robinson spacetime, using the monodromy-matrix formalism associated with integrable sigma models. Starting from the extremal Reissner--Nordström black hole in the Bertotti--Robinson background, we derive the corresponding coset and monodromy matrices and show that they are governed by nilpotent algebraic structures.
